latest.text: Thanks for trying it, and sorry for the confusion. That's a fair point. Trophy Manager reads and writes the console's trophy files, and a normal homebrew app can't open those files by itself. To get to them it talks to Elf Arsenal's local HTTP/FTP servers on the console (127.0.0.1). So it needs Elf Arsenal (and ShadowMountPlus) already running on your jailbroken PS5.
